notes: PSA 4.6 ng/mL. PI-RADS 5. PSAD 0.15. Prostate volume 30 mL. csPCa 0.82.

note_sections.t: Ascending PSA values combined with a previously positive biopsy require specialist re-evaluation.

A 76-year-old non-smoker initially entered evaluation due to a late-2023 PSA elevation. Later, a systematic biopsy confirmed low-grade disease. Type 2 diabetes is managed using empagliflozin. An IPSS score of 2 points to negligible urinary symptom bother. Formerly a police officer, he is divorced and resides with his partner. Weekends feature hiking trips. Alcohol remains capped at 13 units weekly. Orthopaedic follow-ups address a chronic knee issue. Podiatry visits handle foot maintenance. An Arabic interpreter has been requested. Bone pain, haematuria, and unexplained weight loss are denied. Overall wellness stays steady.

DRE: Texture is uniformly smooth. Dimensions are symmetric. No nodularity. No asymmetry. General inspection shows a well-nourished individual appearing comfortable. Vital signs remain stable. Cardiopulmonary assessment is normal.
